snapshot.generalNotes: Ms. Kozma was not present. In fact, I only learned this name after my visit as the main office staff told me there is no teacher for the hydroponic room. As well as the room was not really in use. I spoke to Wyatt about it and he cleared it up with a group chat including the teacher. I moved the vertical NFT that was disassembled and placed it next to the window. I placed the VCS buckets back in the system. I plugged in timers for the seedling station and both Tower Gardens. Both towers are running. The seeds in the seedling station were there since 10/15 but it was unplugged for an undetermined amount of time. There were only medium rockwool cubes so I couldn't plant any seeds. There's a few things missing as well supply wise. Hopefully I will meet with the teacher and learn more on Friday.
